a2a:agent-card.a2a:json: { "name": "${a2a.name}", "description": "${a2a.description}", "url": "${a2a.publicUrl}", "version": "1.0.0", "protocolVersion": "0.3.0", "capabilities": {"streaming": true, "pushNotifications": true, "stateTransitionHistory": false}, "defaultInputModes": ["text/plain"], "defaultOutputModes": ["text/plain"], "skills": [{"id": "chat", "name": "Chat", "description": "Answers questions, using its tools when needed", "tags": ["chat"]}] }

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {kind: 'task', id: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, status: {state: 'completed', message: {kind: 'message', role: 'agent', messageId: uuid(), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: vars.answer}]}}, artifacts: [{artifactId: uuid(), name: 'answer', parts: [{kind: 'text', text: vars.answer}]}]}]

#[output application/json --- {kind: 'task', id: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, status: {state: 'failed', message: {kind: 'message', role: 'agent', messageId: uuid(), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')}]}}}]

a2a:update-task-artifact.a2a:artifact-content: #[output application/json --- {kind: 'artifact-update', taskId: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, artifact: {artifactId: uuid(), name: 'answer', parts: [{kind: 'text', text: vars.answer}]}, lastChunk: true}]

a2a:update-task-status.a2a:status-content: #[output application/json --- {kind: 'status-update', taskId: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, final: true, status: {state: 'completed', message: {kind: 'message', role: 'agent', messageId: uuid(), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: vars.answer}]}}}]

#[output application/json --- {kind: 'status-update', taskId: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, final: true, status: {state: 'failed', message: {kind: 'message', role: 'agent', messageId: uuid(), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')}]}}}]

#[output application/json --- {kind: 'status-update', taskId: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, final: false, status: {state: 'working', message: {kind: 'message', role: 'agent', messageId: uuid(), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: vars.progress default 'working'}]}}}]

a2a:send-message.a2a:message: #[output application/json --- {message: {kind: 'message', role: 'user', messageId: uuid(), contextId: 'peer-' ++ (vars.sid default 'default'), parts: [{kind: 'text', text: payload.text}]}}]

set-payload.value: #[((payload.parts default payload.status.message.parts default []) filter ($.kind == 'text') map $.text) joinBy '\n']
